memo.headline: Edge Compute looks like a Voice AI component, not a standalone category; the evidence is synthetic and samples are small.
memo.evidence: Standalone usage is 12.0% of revenue against a 35.0% effective threshold, and standalone demand is 10.0% against 15.0%. Only 7 of 65 accounts are standalone. Standalone win rate is 25.0% (4 closed deals) versus 75.0% bundled. Self-serve paid conversion within 90 days is 19.4% with voice versus 2.4% without. Retention samples are tiny (n=6 and n=11), and the demand gap is sensitive to the threshold. The call could change if standalone demand or usage cleared its threshold on larger samples. The data is synthetic.
